meta.name: cellxgene-census
meta.description: Query the CZ CELLxGENE Census programmatically for versioned public single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data. Use when you need population-scale cell metadata, gene expression slices, Census summary counts, source H5AD URIs/downloads, embeddings, spatial Census data, or reference atlas comparisons across organisms, tissues, diseases, assays, and cell types. For analyzing your own local single-cell data use scanpy, anndata, or scvi-tools.

copy.tagline: 检索公开的单细胞与空间转录组数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在做单细胞或空间转录组研究想直接从公开图谱获取数据
copy.tagline_en: Query public single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data on demand
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study single-cell biology and want to query public transcriptomics atlases directly.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 可用 Python 查询 CZ CELLxGENE Census 的公开单细胞与空间转录组数据,按细胞类型、组织、疾病等条件筛选,取回细胞元数据、基因表达矩阵、汇总计数或来源 H5AD 链接。
howto.when: 当你需要群体规模的细胞元数据、基因表达切片或 Census 汇总计数等公开数据时触发;若要分析自己本地的单细胞数据,原文建议改用 scanpy、anndata 等工具。

say.text: 用 cellxgene-census 查一下脑组织里有哪些原代细胞类型

say.text: 把肺部 B 细胞的表达数据取出来,只看 CD4 和 CD8A 基因
say.note: 返回按细胞类型和基因过滤的表达矩阵

say.text: 算一下脑组织中 FOXP2、TBR1 基因的平均表达量
say.note: 用分块迭代在内存外累计统计量

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can query CZ CELLxGENE Census public single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data with Python: filter by cell type, tissue or disease to get metadata, expression matrices, summary counts or H5AD source links.
howto.when_en: Use it when you need population-scale cell metadata, gene expression slices or Census summary counts; for your own local single-cell data the doc points to scanpy, anndata or scvi-tools.

say_en.text: Use cellxgene-census to list the primary cell types in brain tissue
say_en.note: Reads brain cell metadata and lists cell types

say_en.text: Pull lung B cell expression data for CD4 and CD8A only
say_en.note: Returns a matrix filtered by cell type and genes

say_en.text: Compute mean expression of FOXP2 and TBR1 in brain
say_en.note: Computes stats out of core in chunks
